title: Provider job submit request (vendor-facing dialect), provider contract v1
description: The body GenericRESTAdapter sends to POST /v1/jobs. Written down because the repository previously had two provider adapters posting two undocumented shapes and only one of them was accepted by the bundled emulator: with MUSIC_PROVIDER=generic_rest every submit was rejected with 422. A vendor implements this; the emulator also accepts its own legacy flat dialect for the built-in adapter, which is NOT part of this contract.

external_request_id.description: Platform job id, also sent as the Idempotency-Key header.

candidate_count.description: Must not exceed the candidate_count_max advertised by /v1/capabilities.

song_spec.description: The locked song spec revision. Providers may ignore fields they do not support; capabilities declare which ones are honoured.
